description: Defines ASN.1 structures for 3GPP NR RRC DL-CCCH messages, including message types and sequence structures.

classes.name: dl_ccch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type in DL-CCCH messages, including reject and setup options.

classes.name: dl_ccch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the full DL-CCCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type (e.g., c1, msg_class_ext).

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Accesses the c1 choice within the message type.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to extended class.
